content.heading: Trace an action through every layer.
content.description: Select an end-to-end flow to inspect how a user interaction translates into an authenticated API route, database SQL query, and observable telemetry.

flows.label: Invite teammate
flows.explanation: Verifies workspace RBAC permissions, creates cryptographically secure invitation token, writes to database with row-level locks, and dispatches an asynchronous worker job to deliver the branded transactional email.

flows.label: Upgrade subscription
flows.query:
UPDATE organizations
SET billing_tier = $1, stripe_customer_id = $2, updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $3
RETURNING id, name, billing_tier;
flows.explanation: Validates customer subscription state in Redis cache, updates customer record in PostgreSQL, and generates an authenticated checkout session with webhook signature verification.

flows.label: Query audit stream
flows.query:
SELECT e.id, e.action, e.actor_id, e.ip_address, e.created_at, u.name AS actor_name
FROM audit_events e
INNER JOIN users u ON u.id = e.actor_id
WHERE e.organization_id = $1
ORDER BY e.created_at DESC
LIMIT 25 OFFSET $2;
flows.explanation: Indexed composite query leveraging connection pooling and read-replica distribution for zero-lag tenant activity monitoring.
